places.name: Neuschwanstein Castle

desc.en: Neuschwanstein Castle is a 19th-century historicist palace on a rugged hill of the foothills of the Alps in the very south of Germany, near the border with Austria.

places.admission: Entry is by timed ticket; book ahead, especially in high season.

desc.en: Heligoland is a small archipelago in the North Sea, administratively part of the German state of Schleswig-Holstein.

places.name: Buchenwald concentration camp

desc.en: Buchenwald was a German Nazi concentration camp established on Ettersberg hill near Weimar, Germany, in July 1937.
desc.es: El campo de concentración de Buchenwald fue uno de los primeros y más grandes campos de concentración en territorio alemán.

places.admission: Guided visits and advance information are recommended.
